title: Time-Based Key-Value Store (progressive)
description_html:
A key-value store where every write carries a timestamp. The interviewer adds a constraint every 10–15 minutes.

Levels

  1. Part 1: timestamped reads
    • set(key, value, timestamp)
    • get(key, timestamp) returns the value written at the latest timestamp ≤ the one asked for
  2. Part 2: edge cases
    • A get with a timestamp later than any write; a key that was never written
  3. Part 3: concurrency
    • Support concurrent reads and writes safely

Constraints / rules

  • Closest LeetCode analog: #981.

Progressive round: each level unlocks after the previous one passes. Write level 1 so later levels extend it rather than rewrite it.

Source: 1point3acres OpenAI report "Time-Based Key-Value Store with Production Testing". Candidate-reported; exact wording varies between reports.
